method: reasonableness: estimate by rounding to the leading digit and compare with the claimed answer (within 25% of both the exact value and the rounded estimate: reasonable, >=1.5x or <=2/3x of both: far off, otherwise ambiguous); product size: option within a factor 2 of the exact product; "needs an exact answer": human classification table of the 16 situations (8 exact / 8 estimate), exactly one exact per question
assumptions: classification of two borderline situations (chairs for 32 guests, gold weight) as exact is a judgement
